t: The Saxby Trimless tilt downlight offers a modern recessed lighting solution for a clean, seamless ceiling finish. This plaster-in downlight is ideal for new builds and renovations, allowing for installation during early construction stages before the light bulb is fitted. It features a durable aluminium alloy body and a 20° tilt, providing fully adjustable illumination. With an 82mm cut-out diameter and a shallow 20mm recess depth, it integrates discreetly into ceilings. The downlight requires 1 x GU10 light bulb, making it suitable for both domestic and commercial indoor lighting projects.
